title: Argentinian Fried Apple Delight
description: A delicious and crispy dessert inspired by Argentinian cuisine, featuring sweet fried apples and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a bowl, mix together rice flour, granulated sugar, and salt.
Add the zesty lemon juice to the mixture and stir until combined.
Peel and slice the apples into thin pieces.
Dip each apple slice into the mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Carefully place the coated apple slices into the hot oil.
Fry the apples for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried apples from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fried apples warm, garnished with additional granulated sugar if desired.
Serve the fried apples alongside the fried rice.
